samples.name: prop-monument-pedestal
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Supplied Kenney sheets are STYLE references only. Single 16x16 world prop for medieval Slavic village game. Square grey stone pedestal with stepped base and flat top, small ground shadow. No statue or figure, empty pedestal. Strict 16x16 logical pixel grid enlarged to square canvas. Each logical pixel a large flat square. Fit within 14x14 pixels centered, one pixel clear margin. Extremely simple Kenney Tiny Town silhouette, exactly three flat stone grey shades, top-left light. South-facing top-down three-quarter view, not isometric. Fully transparent background and gaps. No text, scenery, gradients, antialiasing, haze, neon fringes, fine texture, pure black outlines or extra panels.
